title: Compatibility of the chosen matching
statement: Let $n,k,q$ be natural numbers, and let $S_0,\ldots,S_{q-1}$ be subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ whose symmetric difference is empty and each of which has cardinality $k$. Choose a bijection from the $k$ positions to the elements of each subset and a permutation of the positions in each part. In the complete multipartite graph with $q$ parts of size $k$, the chosen perfect matching is compatible with the resulting vertex labeling: the two endpoints of every matching edge have the same label.
hypotheses_covered: The tuple of $q$ subsets has empty symmetric difference
A bijection from positions to each subset is chosen
A permutation of positions is specified for each part
